meta.title: Add SIMD optimizations for 23.5% performance improvement
meta.body_summary: Introduce SIMD optimizations for tokenization, pattern matching, and ranking in the probe code search engine, achieving up to 17% term matching speedup and 11.8% overall improvement with hybrid SIMD/ripgrep strategy.

perf_labels.notes: Claude_Code contributed SIMD modules with benchmark tables; merged by same maintainer after bot feedback and thread-safety/regression fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 4680 changed lines across 22 files, this is a large refactor by absolute volume. The addition of SIMD modules and deep integration into search pipeline makes it a substantial performance optimization, which merged after self-review and iterative bot-guided fixes.

review_details.concern_detail: probeaidev[bot] flagged three issues: non-thread-safe env var manipulation in simd_tokenization.rs, incomplete SIMD element-wise multiply for BM25 ranking, and inefficient sparse-to-dense conversion in SIMD dot product. Maintainer (also author) subsequently addressed thread safety with SimdConfig struct and fixed ripgrep regression.
review_details.performance_claim: 23.5% overall improvement (11.8% net after overhead), 17% term matching speedup, 7.2% tokenization improvement, and hybrid SIMD/ripgrep yielding 13.9% best-case.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: SIMD optimization requires expert knowledge of CPU intrinsics and Rust libraries; the agent delivered working modules but maintainer intervention was needed for thread safety and a 21x regression fix, highlighting the need for senior oversight on low-level performance work.

detection_detail.code_reading: probeaidev bot analyzed the code and flagged thread safety, incomplete SIMD, and memory inefficiencies; maintainer (author) reviewed the suggestions and implemented fixes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes detailed timing tables and strategy comparisons, but no raw logs or scripts for independent reproduction. The benchmarks are single-scenario measurements.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Thread safety issues with env var manipulation were fixed via SimdConfig struct; a 21x ripgrep integration regression was corrected by reverting to regex-based approach while preserving pre-compilation benefits, all within the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Added SIMD-accelerated tokenization (camelCase splitting with smart fallback), pattern matching (memchr, aho-corasick with hybrid ripgrep), and ranking modules; introduced thread-safe configuration, benchmark suite, and fixed C#/Swift tree-sitter parsing alongside the optimization.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: ripgrep_searcher.rs underwent heavy refactoring to fix a 21x regression; CLAUDE.md and site/ files contain documentation updates.
change_trajectory: Initial commit introduces SIMD tokenization, pattern matching, and ranking with benchmarks.
Merge of main branch brings ripgrep searcher and creates hybrid architecture.
SIMD enabled by default with opt-out flags; smart fallback for complex patterns added.
C# and Swift tree-sitter parsing bugs resolved.
Bot review requested; feedback highlighted thread safety, incomplete SIMD, and memory inefficiencies.
Thread safety fixed via SimdConfig struct; additional infrastructure improvements made.
21x ripgrep regression fixed by reverting to regex-based approach while maintaining pre-compilation.

review_signals.summary: Maintainer asked probeaidev bot to review SIMD implementation and correctness.
Recommended: replace env var manipulation with config struct for thread safety, fully implement SIMD element-wise multiply for BM25, and optimize sparse-to-dense conversion.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer committed SimdConfig refactor and memory improvements in follow-up commits.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with SIMD modules and benchmarks; no formal human reviewers.
Maintainer (also author) triggered bot review with /review command.
Bot commented on thread safety, incomplete SIMD, and memory patterns.
Maintainer committed thread-safe config, general SIMD infrastructure enhancements, and fixed an unrelated 21x ripgrep regression.
PR merged by same maintainer after iterative self-review and bot-assisted analysis.
